placeholders.why: The New Discount Experience activation block, verbatim, for merging into the host's Files/GlobalSettings.config. Without it EcomDiscounts rows are accepted, active, correct on read-back and never consulted at cart time (Foundry 1048). A layer cannot ship GlobalSettings.config itself - the files overlay is overwrite-wins and would replace the host's connection and licence configuration - so the block ships as a fragment with its apply and proof steps in-file.

customCode.withoutCompile: Customer-contract pricing is the zero-code headline: the buyer-scoped EcomPrices row (TC-PRICE-CTR-0046, PriceUserCustomerNumber TC-100200) is resolved and charged end-to-end by Dynamicweb's stock DefaultPriceProvider with NO custom code — TCPROD0046 prices 36.90 for the demo account (list 45.00, customer-group row 39.60). The quantity-tier EcomPrices rows (TC-PRICE-Q05/Q10/Q25-0020 on TCPROD0020) ship as data and render on tier-aware surfaces, but the stock cart resolver ignores tier quantities at cart time, so uncompiled the cart charges the customer-group price for tiers.
customCode.withCompile: Compiling ReorderingPricingQtyBreakProvider (PriceProvider, discovered by assembly-scan; non-exclusive, HandlePricesExclusively=false) ADDS cart-time enforcement of the quantity tiers: TCPROD0020 prices 108/96/84 at qty 5/10/25 against a 120 list. The provider returns a price ONLY for real tiers (Quantity > 1); base and contract rows fall through to the default provider, so contract pricing is identical whether or not it is compiled.
customCode.compileStep: Opt-in per the dynamicweb-skills feature-layer compile recipe (D3): add src/*.cs to the Swift solution's custom-code project and build; the provider self-registers via assembly scan (no config row required).
